;Armed conflicts and attacks
*[[War in Afghanistan (2001–2021)]]
**A series of [[United States|U.S.]] airstrikes kills at least 30 [[Afghanistan|Afghan]] civilians, including 16 children, in [[Garmsir District]], [[Helmand Province]]. Additional civilians were left injured or buried in the rubble. The target of the strikes was a suspected [[Taliban]] compound. The United States' strategy aims to push the Taliban into talks. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-afghanistan-airstrike/thirty-afghan-civilians-killed-in-u-s-air-strike-officials-say-idUSKCN1NX1N8 (Reuters)]
**At least 10 people are killed and 19 are wounded in an attack on a compound of the [[G4S]] security contracting company in the Afghan capital [[Kabul]]. The Taliban's strategy seeks to strengthen its position before any formal negotiations. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2018/11/explosion-reported-afghan-capital-kabul-casualties-feared-181128141320254.html (Al Jazeera)]

;Disasters and accidents
*A chain reaction of exploding trucks triggered by a blast during the delivery of [[acetylene|acetylene gas]] at a chemical plant in [[Zhangjiakou]], [[China]], kills 23 people and injures at least 22 others. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-china-blast/blast-kills-22-in-chinas-hebei-province-injures-22-others-idUSKCN1NX03N (Reuters)]
*[[Flash flood]]ing kills two people and causes major power outages in [[Sydney]], [[Australia]]. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-australia-46366961 (BBC)]

;International relations
*[[India–Pakistan relations]]
**Personalities from both countries inaugurate a corridor that will enable [[Sikh]] pilgrims to travel visa-free between the Indian town of [[Dera Baba Nanak]] and the [[Gurdwara Darbar Sahib Kartarpur|Sri Kartarpur Sahib Gurdwara]] in Pakistan. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2018/11/pakistan-india-break-ground-visa-free-kartarpur-corridor-181128111752755.html (Al Jazeera)]

;Politics and elections
*[[Malagasy presidential election, 2018]]
**Two  former presidents, [[Andry Rajoelina]] and [[Marc Ravalomanana]], advance to the second round, due to be held on December 19. Incumbent [[List of Presidents of Madagascar|president]] [[Hery Rajaonarimampianina]] is eliminated. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-madagascar-election/madagascar-ex-presidents-to-compete-in-second-round-vote-incumbent-out-idUSKCN1NX0RP (Reuters)]
*Doctors and firefighters strike in [[Catalonia]], [[Spain]], over budget cuts, ending with clashes between demonstrators and [[Mossos d'Esquadra]] at the doors of [[Parliament of Catalonia|Catalan Parliament]]. Students and teachers start a two-day strike. [https://elpais.com/elpais/2018/11/28/inenglish/1543405326_989953.html (''El País'')]
;Sports
*[[World Chess Championship 2018]]
**[[Magnus Carlsen]] retains the title after a 3–0 victory against [[Fabiano Caruana]] in the best-of-four [[Rapid chess|rapid]] tiebreaking series. [https://www.theguardian.com/sport/2018/nov/28/magnus-carlsen-beats-fabiano-caruana-in-world-chess-championship-tie-breakers (''The Guardian'')]
